constitutional_components.SovSpace: evidence, dependency, correction and history graph

principles: Owner-controlled infrastructure may be changed under the owner-authorised lane.
Third-party systems, committees, projects, registries and standards bodies remain externally governed and are never represented as controlled by CSOAI.
Public information may be measured, indexed, reproduced and linked permissionlessly when lawful and technically permitted.
Measurement never becomes certification merely because it is signed, anchored, paid for, or displayed on a CSOAI site.
A payment may commission work but cannot buy a result, suppress a correction, or create board placement.
Every material governance state must be correctable, supersedable and attributable to evidence.
